name: MAT267H1 — Deductive Derivation (Bifurcations)
description: Bifurcation: small parameter change → QUALITATIVE change in behavior. Fixed points appear, disappear, or change stability. Bifurcation diagram: fixed

steps.template_en: Bifurcation: small parameter change → QUALITATIVE change in behavior. Fixed points appear, disappear, or change stability. Bifurcation diagram: fixed points vs parameter.
steps.template_zh: 分岔：参数小变化→行为质变。不动点出现、消失或改变稳定性。分岔图：不动点vs参数。

steps.template_en: Saddle-node: x'=μ-x². μ<0: no fixed points. μ=0: one (x=0, semi-stable). μ>0: two (x=±√μ, one stable, one unstable). Pair of fixed points born from nothing.
steps.template_zh: 鞍结分岔：x'=μ-x²。μ<0: 无不动点。μ=0: 一个(x=0,半稳定)。μ>0: 两个(x=±√μ,一稳定一不稳定)。一对不动点从无中生有。

steps.template_en: Pitchfork: x'=μx-x³. μ<0: one stable at 0. μ>0: 0 unstable, two new stable appear. SUPERCRITICAL. Subcritical: x'=μx+x³ — stable becomes unstable, no nearby stable → jump.
steps.template_zh: 叉形：x'=μx-x³。μ<0: 一个稳定在0。μ>0: 0变不稳定，两个新稳定出现。超临界。亚临界：x'=μx+x³。

steps.template_en: Hopf: periodic orbit born from fixed point when eigenvalues cross imaginary axis. Example: r'=μr-r³, θ'=1. Supercritical: μ>0 → stable limit cycle.
steps.template_zh: Hopf分岔：特征值穿越虚轴时周期轨道从不动点产生。例：r'=μr-r³, θ'=1。超临界：μ>0→稳定极限环。

steps.template_en: Bifurcations explain: (1) Population dynamics (Allee effect). (2) Laser threshold. (3) Neuron firing. (4) Buckling beam. (5) Heart rhythm → arrhythmia.
steps.template_zh: 分岔解释：(1)种群动力学(Allee效应)。(2)激光阈值。(3)神经元放电。(4)屈曲梁。(5)心律失常。

steps.template_en: Only a few UNIVERSAL bifurcations: saddle-node, pitchfork, Hopf, transcritical. Center Manifold Theorem reduces high-dim systems to these normal forms.
steps.template_zh: 只有少数普适分岔：鞍结、叉形、Hopf、跨临界。中心流形定理将高维系统约化为这些规范型。
